title: Vault configuration
description: augment_wiki/config.yaml, the only hand-written file in the wiki folder. Nothing regenerates or reorders it. It holds what the person declares, which is the opposite of the index: machine state projected from the ledger and never hand-edited.

contract_version.description: The plugin release that last compiled this vault. Where it does not match the installed plugin, the cycle reports a migration notice rather than compiling on.

house_language.description: ISO 639-1. The wiki is monolingual. Derived once from the sources, asked where they disagree, en by default. Changing it later means recompiling the wiki.

author.description: The person's name or initials, used as the actor in a [!note] callout. Asked for and written here rather than hardcoded, so the system stays usable on any vault.

source_contexts.description: How the sources view groups the source layer.

scope.description: What the system may read. Silence fails closed: a missing or empty config reads as no rules and therefore no folder in scope.

ignore.description: Never knowledge: scratch, staging, infrastructure. Never counted, asked about, or read.

rules.description: Precedence is longest path first, and an explicit tag on a note always wins. A path no rule touches is undecided, which is reported as a decision owed rather than treated as out of scope.

default.description: The declaration made once for every file under this path. A folder in scope with no default leaves its notes undeclared.

harvest.description: Project logs worked for dated decisions only, a narrower declaration than #to-process. Declared per project cluster at the sweep rather than assumed from silence.

memory.description: The memory layer (reference/memory.md). Optional; every key has a default, and memory runs on the defaults once the first card is written.

enabled.description: false stops every memory write and the session-start load. Default true.

inject_chars.description: Characters of memory loaded at session start. Default 6000.

decay_days.description: An active card seen once and untouched this long is proposed for archiving. Default 180.

skills.description: Skills kept in the vault (reference/skills.md). Optional; without it no skill folder is read through the connector or checked.

root.description: Vault-relative folder holding one folder per skill: its thin SKILL.md, references/ read live, CHANGELOG.md and dist/. Rule the same folder out of scope, so it is never compiled.
